note: Community question bank for GCP Study Hub. Each question: id, cert, domain, question, options[], answer (index into options), explanation. Contributions welcome via PR.

questions.question: A company wants to run containerized microservices without managing the underlying node infrastructure. Which Google Cloud product best fits?
questions.explanation: Cloud Run runs stateless containers serverlessly, scaling to zero with no node management. Compute Engine would require managing VMs.

questions.domain: Innovating with data and Google Cloud
questions.question: Which service is a serverless data warehouse for running SQL analytics over very large datasets?
questions.explanation: BigQuery is Google Cloud's serverless analytics data warehouse. Bigtable is operational NoSQL, Firestore is a document DB, and Cloud SQL is managed relational.

questions.question: Under Google Cloud's shared responsibility model, who is responsible for configuring IAM policies and securing customer data?
questions.explanation: Google secures the underlying infrastructure (security OF the cloud); the customer is responsible for IAM configuration and their data (security IN the cloud).

questions.domain: Introduction to digital transformation with Google Cloud
questions.question: Moving from buying servers upfront to paying only for cloud resources consumed is an example of shifting from:
questions.explanation: Cloud shifts spending from capital expenditure (buying hardware upfront) to operational expenditure (pay for what you use).

questions.domain: Innovating with data and Google Cloud
questions.question: A team needs to ingest a high-volume real-time stream of events for later processing. Which service is designed for this?
questions.explanation: Pub/Sub is a scalable messaging service for ingesting and distributing real-time event streams.

questions.question: An IAM policy granting Viewer is set at the folder level and Editor at the project level for the same user. What is the user's effective access on resources in that project?
options: The union: Editor (which includes Viewer-level read)
questions.explanation: IAM policies are inherited and additive. The effective policy is the union of all levels, so the user has Editor (which already includes read access).

questions.domain: Deploying and implementing a cloud solution
questions.question: Which resource provides autoscaling, autohealing, and rolling updates for a group of identical Compute Engine VMs?
questions.explanation: A Managed Instance Group uses an instance template and provides autoscaling, autohealing, and rolling updates. Unmanaged groups do not.

questions.domain: Planning and configuring a cloud solution
questions.question: In Google Cloud networking, what is the scope of a VPC network and of a subnet?
options: VPC is zonal; subnet is regional
VPC is global; subnet is regional
VPC is regional; subnet is zonal
questions.explanation: A VPC network is a global resource, while subnets are regional and span all zones in their region.

questions.question: What is the recommended way to give a Compute Engine VM permission to call Google Cloud APIs?
options: Embed a user's password in the VM
Download a service account JSON key onto the VM
Attach a service account to the VM
questions.explanation: Attaching a service account to the VM is preferred. Downloading JSON keys is discouraged because keys are long-lived secrets that can leak.

questions.domain: Ensuring successful operation of a cloud solution
questions.question: Which command sets the active project for subsequent gcloud commands?
questions.explanation: gcloud config set project PROJECT_ID sets the active project in the current configuration.

questions.domain: Planning and configuring a cloud solution
questions.question: A private VM with no external IP needs outbound internet access to download OS updates. What should you configure?
questions.explanation: Cloud NAT provides outbound internet access for instances without external IP addresses, without exposing them to inbound connections.

questions.domain: Designing and planning a cloud solution architecture
questions.question: An application requires a relational database that is globally distributed with strong consistency and 99.999% availability. Which service fits best?
questions.explanation: Spanner provides globally distributed, strongly consistent relational data with up to 99.999% availability in multi-region configurations. Cloud SQL is regional.

questions.question: To prevent data exfiltration from BigQuery and Cloud Storage to resources outside a trusted boundary, you should implement:
questions.explanation: VPC Service Controls create a security perimeter around managed services like BigQuery and Cloud Storage to mitigate data exfiltration.

questions.question: In SRE terms, what does an error budget represent?
options: The money allocated to fixing bugs
The allowed amount of unreliability, equal to 1 minus the SLO
The number of engineers on call
questions.explanation: The error budget is the acceptable level of unreliability, calculated as 1 minus the SLO. It governs how much risk a team can take with releases.

questions.domain: Analyzing and optimizing technical and business processes
questions.question: A steady, predictable batch workload runs 24/7 on Compute Engine. Which pricing approach minimizes cost while guaranteeing capacity?
questions.explanation: Committed use discounts offer significant savings for steady, predictable workloads while guaranteeing capacity. Spot VMs are cheaper but can be preempted.

questions.question: To decouple a web frontend from backend processing with at-least-once delivery and fan-out to multiple subscribers, you should use:
questions.explanation: Pub/Sub provides many-to-many, at-least-once messaging with fan-out to multiple subscribers. Cloud Tasks is for explicit, rate-limited task dispatch to a single worker.

questions.question: You want to roll out a new Cloud Run revision to 10% of traffic before full release. What feature enables this?
questions.explanation: Cloud Run supports traffic splitting across revisions, enabling canary deployments by sending a percentage of traffic to a new revision.

questions.question: Which service should store database passwords and API keys for an application?
questions.explanation: Secret Manager securely stores and version-controls secrets like passwords and API keys, with IAM-based access and audit logging.

questions.question: Which pair correctly describes an SLI and an SLO?
options: SLI is a legal contract; SLO is a measurement
SLI is a measured indicator; SLO is a target for that indicator
SLO is a measured indicator; SLI is a penalty
questions.explanation: An SLI (Service Level Indicator) is a measured value such as latency or error rate; an SLO (Service Level Objective) is the target for that SLI.

questions.question: Which Google Cloud service provides managed progressive delivery (e.g., canary) to GKE and Cloud Run?
questions.explanation: Cloud Deploy is a managed continuous delivery service that orchestrates progressive rollouts to targets like GKE and Cloud Run. Cloud Build handles the CI/build step.

questions.question: What is the most secure way for an on-prem or external workload to authenticate to Google Cloud without long-lived keys?
options: Download a service account JSON key
questions.explanation: Workload Identity Federation lets external identities impersonate service accounts using short-lived credentials, avoiding long-lived JSON keys.

questions.question: Which service discovers, classifies, and de-identifies sensitive data such as PII?
questions.explanation: Sensitive Data Protection (formerly Cloud DLP) discovers, classifies, and de-identifies or tokenizes sensitive data like PII.

questions.question: You need a globally scoped Layer 7 load balancer with Cloud CDN for a web application. Which do you choose?
questions.explanation: The global external Application Load Balancer operates at Layer 7, is global, and integrates with Cloud CDN - ideal for global web apps.

questions.question: Which option provides a highly available VPN connection to Google Cloud with a 99.99% SLA?
questions.explanation: HA VPN provides a 99.99% availability SLA using redundant tunnels and interfaces. Classic VPN offers a lower SLA.

questions.domain: Designing scalable and highly available databases
questions.question: An IoT platform ingests millions of time-series writes per second with single-digit millisecond reads. Which database fits best?
questions.explanation: Bigtable is a wide-column NoSQL database designed for very high throughput and low-latency reads/writes, ideal for time-series and IoT workloads.

questions.question: Which service performs minimal-downtime database migrations into Cloud SQL or AlloyDB with continuous replication?
questions.explanation: Database Migration Service (DMS) performs homogeneous and heterogeneous database migrations with continuous replication for minimal downtime.

questions.question: Which service runs unified batch and streaming data pipelines serverlessly using Apache Beam?
questions.explanation: Dataflow is the serverless Apache Beam runner for unified batch and streaming pipelines. Dataproc runs managed Spark/Hadoop clusters.

questions.domain: Preparing and using data for analysis
questions.question: To reduce the cost of on-demand BigQuery queries that filter by date, you should:
options: Store data as CSV in Cloud Storage
Partition the table by date and cluster by common filter columns
questions.explanation: Partitioning by date and clustering by frequently filtered columns reduces the bytes scanned, directly lowering on-demand query cost.

questions.question: Which service provides managed Apache Airflow for orchestrating data pipelines?
questions.explanation: Cloud Composer is managed Apache Airflow, used to author, schedule, and monitor complex data pipeline workflows.

questions.question: An application needs low-latency, real-time predictions from a trained model. Which Vertex AI capability should you use?
questions.explanation: Vertex AI online prediction deploys a model to an endpoint for low-latency, real-time inference. Batch prediction is for large, non-interactive jobs.

questions.question: Which Vertex AI feature helps detect training/serving skew and feature drift in production models?
questions.explanation: Vertex AI Model Monitoring tracks input feature distributions to detect training/serving skew and drift, alerting when models degrade.

questions.domain: Collaborating to manage data and models
questions.question: What is the purpose of Vertex AI Feature Store?
options: To centrally manage and serve ML features for reuse and consistency
questions.explanation: Vertex AI Feature Store centralizes feature management and serving, promoting reuse and reducing training/serving skew.

questions.question: Which tool is best for building interactive dashboards on top of BigQuery for business users?
questions.explanation: Looker Studio (and Looker) create interactive dashboards and reports, commonly connected to BigQuery for self-serve BI.

questions.question: A low-code, visual way to build ETL pipelines on Google Cloud is provided by:
questions.explanation: Cloud Data Fusion is a fully managed, visual (low-code) data integration service for building ETL/ELT pipelines.

questions.question: Which Workspace feature enforces access decisions based on device and context (such as IP or device security status)?
questions.explanation: Context-Aware Access applies granular access controls to Workspace apps based on user identity, device posture, and context like IP location.

questions.domain: Managing user accounts, domains, and directory
questions.question: What is the primary purpose of Organizational Units (OUs) in Google Workspace?
options: To apply settings and service policies hierarchically to groups of users
questions.explanation: OUs let administrators apply settings and control service access hierarchically to subsets of users within the organization.
